## Junk Butler 1.0

First release.

- Sells every grey item that has a vendor price as soon as you open a vendor, a few items at a time.
- Repairs all your gear at vendors that can repair, paid from your own gold. If your gold is short, it tries once more after the sale.
- One chat line tells you how many items were sold, for how much, and what the repair cost.
- Hold Shift while you open a vendor to skip both for that visit.
- `/jb` or `/junkbutler` shows the settings. `/jb sell` and `/jb repair` switch each half on or off.

## Junk Butler 1.1

- New **keep list**: grey items on it are never sold. Handy for joke items, keepsakes and grey transmog pieces.
- `/jb keep` followed by an item link (shift-click the item) or an item ID adds it. Several items in one command work too.
- `/jb unkeep` followed by a link or ID takes an item off the list again. `/jb keep` on its own lists everything on it.
- The keep list is shared by all characters of your account, so you only set it up once.
- After a sale, the chat line also says how many items were kept.
